subject: Commit ceiling & price-hold proposal for AtlasFleet renewal
messages:
From: Elaine Park <elaine@atlasfleet.com>
To: markus_klein@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Cc: Chris Norton <chris.norton@atlasfleet.com>, infra@atlasfleet.com
Date: Mon, 12 Apr 2027 08:14:00 -0700
Subject: Q: renewal pricing and commit ceiling

Hi Markus / Laura,

Quick context: our current annual commit with Redwood renews at the end of May. We expect a material uptick in vehicle telemetry ingestion in Q3 because of a new partner onboarding; estimated token volume could spike ~35% for 6-8 weeks.

Procurement wants clarity on three items before sign-off:
- Can Redwood guarantee a price-hold for the renewal term if we increase committed spend?
- Is there a mechanism for short-term credits/capacity bridging for the Q3 spike?
- What are the overage rates if we exceed the committed bucket?

We are evaluating two internal options (increase commit vs accept overages) and want to see Redwood's recommended path so we can finalize internal approvals.

Attaching the draft SOW we have on our side (attached). Can someone outline a proposal with numbers?

Thanks,
Elaine Park
Head of Platform Engineering
AtlasFleet

Attachment: AtlasFleet_SOW_v2.pdf
From: markus_klein@redwood.ai
To: Elaine Park <elaine@atlasfleet.com>, Chris Norton <chris.norton@atlasfleet.com>, infra@atlasfleet.com
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 13 Apr 2027 10:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Q: renewal pricing and commit ceiling

Thanks for the clear context, Elaine — helpful. High level response below; attaching a worksheet with the calculations.

Option A — 12-month price-hold with commit increase (preferred for unit economics):
- Commit increase: +20% annual tokens -> discounted per-token rate locked for 12 months.
- One-time onboarding credit to cover first-month spike (covers ~40% of expected 6-8 week uplift).
- Lower overage rate (15% premium over committed rate) during the term.

Option B — Short bridging credits + higher overage (lower upfront commit):
- 6-month price-hold at current rate, plus a Q3 spike credit pool (one-time).
- Overage rate higher (30% premium) beyond credits.

Tradeoffs: Option A minimizes unit cost and is predictable for forecasting; Option B is lighter on cash/commit but costs more at marginal usage.

Next steps I suggest:
1) Internal call (Markus, Laura, Connor) to finalize economics and legal language.
2) Send formal proposal to Procurement (Chris) with clear DocuSign path.

I attached a pricing workbook showing both scenarios. If this looks reasonable I can convert Option A into a redline for the SOW.

Best,
Markus Klein
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Attachment: pricing_workbook_q2.xlsx
From: markus_klein@redwood.ai
To: laura_bennett@redwood.ai, connor_obrien@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 14 Apr 2027 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Internal: AtlasFleet renewal - proposed pricing buckets and margin impact

Team — internal note (do not forward yet).

Summary of proposed structure for discussion with legal/finance:
- Tier 1 (Base): +10% commit -> price hold for 6 months; overage = +30%
- Tier 2 (Growth): +20% commit -> price hold for 12 months; one-time Q3 spike credit equal to 25% of expected incremental spend; overage = +15%
- Tier 3 (Enterprise): +35% commit -> price hold for 18 months; deeper discount and priority capacity; overage = +10%

Finance notes: Tier 2 preserves margin while giving AtlasFleet predictability — likely best for renewal conversion. If they sign Tier 3 we can offer a small additional credit to offset their partner onboarding costs.

Legal notes to consider (Connor): we should be explicit about when credits apply (first-use window for Q3 only) and define overage calculation on a daily rolling basis to avoid disputes. Also propose a soft cap clause that allows temporary autoscaling for partner onboarding with a pre-agreed notification process.

Please review the attached workbook for P&L and send quick thumbs up / edits by EOD Friday so I can present to Procurement next week.

-Markus

From: markus_klein@redwood.ai
To: Elaine Park <elaine@atlasfleet.com>, Chris Norton <chris.norton@atlasfleet.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 20 Apr 2027 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Proposal: Commit tiers + price-hold and Q3 credit (AtlasFleet renewal)

Hi Elaine / Chris —

Thanks for the patience while we modeled options. Based on your expected Q3 spike and internal priorities, we recommend the following binding proposal (summary):

Recommended (Tier 2 - Growth):
- Annual commit: +20% from current baseline.
- Price-hold: 12 months from effective date; per-token rate locked.
- Q3 Credit: One-time credit equal to 25% of expected incremental spend (applies to invoices for July–Sept).
- Overage: 15% premium over committed rate after credits are exhausted.
- Soft cap/overflow: Temporary autoscaling allowed for partner onboarding; usage beyond soft cap billed at overage rates but we will provide near-real-time alerts.

We believe this balances predictability and cost control. Attached is an updated SOW (v3) with the clause language and a DocuSign link for signature. If you confirm, I'll route to legal and we can get the signature executed this week.

DocuSign: https://www.docusign.net/Member/PowerFormSigning.aspx?env=na1&token=abc123

Regards,
Markus Klein
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Phone: (415) 555-0192

Attachment: AtlasFleet_SOW_v3.pdf
From: Chris Norton <chris.norton@atlasfleet.com>
To: markus_klein@redwood.ai
Cc: Elaine Park <elaine@atlasfleet.com>, laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 30 Apr 2027 16:21:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Proposal: Commit tiers + price-hold and Q3 credit (AtlasFleet renewal)

Markus — appreciate the clear proposal. Procurement and Engineering reviewed it. We are prepared to move forward on Tier 2 provided one minor tweak: extend the price-hold from 12 months to 15 months if we commit to a +25% annual commit instead of +20%. That extension is important for our budget window.

If Redwood can accept that trade (commit +25% => price-hold 15 months), we will countersign the SOW via the DocuSign link today. Please confirm and send an updated DocuSign packet.

Thanks,
Chris Norton
Senior Procurement Manager
AtlasFleet
